notes: Copenhagen + Frederiksberg kommuner (Frederiksberg is the enclave inside Copenhagen; added 2026-10). Each property carries `jurisdiction` (municipality) and `district` (parish/sogn; all of Frederiksberg is one region because its parish source, DAWA, closed in 2025). Raw GeoParquet path (~40k features), no PMTiles.

SOURCE (rebuilt 2026-10, run_copenhagen.py): Vurderingsstyrelsen's public valuation map Vurderingsportalen, whose three national FlatGeobufs (vurddb / vurddb_moderej / vurddb_ejl at vurderingsportalen.dk/kort/data/) are bbox-read over HTTP. One feature per valued property, newest published grundværdi: owner-occupied homes 2024 preliminary, rental/co-op/commercial (erhverv) 2025 preliminary. Land in parks/exempt public land comes from the last DAWA jordstykker pull (cached), with 0 or no value.

CONDO BUILDINGS: the master property (moderejendom) carries no land value; each condo unit's grundværdi is summed onto the building (113k units, 4,529 buildings). The July build shipped 3,441 of 3,568 Copenhagen condo buildings at 0 kr and valued rental/co-op/commercial buildings at the frozen pre-2020 (legacy) grundværdi, ~10x below the current figure; together that made rowhouses look far pricier than the apartment city (Victor Mayland Nielsen, Utrecht University, 2026-10).

Erhverv preliminary valuations publish land value only, so full_market_value / improvement_value are null for them; their Underdeveloped test uses the legacy ejendomsværdi:grundværdi ratio (building_share_basis). Copenhagen land use comes from the VUR benyttelseskode; Frederiksberg erhverv land use is estimated from Overture building types (category_source).

Parking Lot category uses the standard apply_parking_category rule (>=50% surface-parking coverage, land-dominant). The July rule tagged any parcel hosting a lot and painted Fælledparken, Kastellet and Botanisk Have as parking.
